data.title: 贝塔 · 绯樱石庭的和风漫步
data.description: 京都风格的枯山水和风庭院中，落樱在青石小径上铺满粉雪。贝塔身穿春樱和风小振袖，手撑绯红油纸伞回眸浅笑。
data.location: tranquil zen garden with stone lanterns and fluttering cherry blossom petals
data.action: strolling along stone path holding an open red oil-paper umbrella, glancing back over shoulder with a delicate shy smile as petals drift by
data.promptProse: Beta in a floral sakura kimono walks along a stone garden path holding a paper umbrella, looking back with a sweet blushing smile among drifting petals.
data.animaCaption: Pink petals drift past her red umbrella as she turns back with a soft smile.
